title: Oil firms roll back fuel prices for 3rd straight week

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Another round of across-the-board oil price rollbacks will take effect this week, marking the third consecutive week of reductions amid recovering global supply and easing tensions in the Middle East. Data released by the Department of Energy (DOE) on Monday showed that gasoline prices will go down by PHP3 per liter, diesel by PHP2.60 per liter, and kerosene by PHP1.60 per liter. Seaoil and Petro Gazz will implement the same adjustments effective 6 a.m. Tuesday (Nov. 24), according to separate advisories.
